scripts.build: cp -f ../bazel-bin/*.wasm ./src && cp -f ../bazel-bin/*.js ./src && sed -i 's/new URL("ikaria",import.meta.url)/new URL("ikaria.js",import.meta.url)/g' src/ikaria.js && rm -rf dist && tsc && cp src/ikaria.wasm dist/ && pnpm minify && cp src/_headers dist/
scripts.minify: for f in dist/*.js; do terser "$f" -o "$f" --compress --mangle --module; done
